newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in thin trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed unmoved against the dollar in range-bound trade on Friday, due to the market being well supplied with the greenback, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.43 to the dollar, after trading between 58.43 and 58.46, they said.
"There was very little commercial demand for dollars and the market was so well supplied, that it hardly made an aimpact," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at the opening level of 10 percent, despite a big state bank borrowing, dealers said.
"Just goes to show how liquid the money market is also," said the BAN Amro dealer.
